scope: Determine whether current writer state can prove that FIELD/FIELDLIST references resolve to records actually emitted by the DXF transaction.

sources.observation: DxfWriterRecordScope stages and commits a byte range but does not capture DXF record type, section, source identity, or emitted code-5 handle.
EntityRecordScope combines byte commit with RecordStateScope for selected entity/table-entry writers; it is not a universal record-emission observer.
writeObjects stages writer-owned and adapter-callback object records inside a larger OBJECTS transaction, then commits the section bytes and record state together.
The existing sourceHandleToMintedMap APIs are scoped to source entities and selected preserved raw records; their contract does not claim a complete output-object inventory.
The transaction exposes its output stream but keeps its temporary path private and has no pre-publication readback or record-verification API.
OBJECTS writing and EOF complete before finalizeDxfWrite and atomic output commit; a complete staged-output validator could be added before publication, but no such hook exists today.
hasCompleteAutoCadFieldGraph builds knownObjectHandles from adapter candidate collections before checking FIELD edges, not from writer-confirmed published records.

requiredNextGates: Resolve FIELD producer wire semantics independently of self-round-trip.

Add generated ASCII and binary tests for rollback, duplicate identity, unresolved/wrong-type targets, remapping, and following-record framing.
Enable only an explicitly qualified subset; retain failure-closed behavior otherwise.
